title: Mat-O-Lab DataStack

narrative_arc.enters_knowing: They heard about the DataStack or landed from a search. No prior knowledge assumed.
narrative_arc.leaves_knowing: The pipeline principle, what outputs they get, which audience entry point matches them, one real-world proof point.
steps: Core principle block quote — one sentence that captures the whole idea
Audience tab switcher — four tabs, each linking directly to their entry point
Use case gallery — three concrete examples (lab CSV, OMERO microscopy, SAMM/Catena-X) with one-sentence outcome each
Proof of production — Hanke et al. 2023 citation + 26 Catena-X mappings statistic
Call to action — quickstart link for data engineers, pipeline link for researchers

inline_assets_required.description: One-sentence core principle (already exists as block quote — verify it's kept)
inline_assets_required.sample: > Create complete, consistent metadata for a non-semantic resource — then use semantic technologies to transform that further.

inline_assets_required.description: Use case gallery: three rows, columns: Domain | Source | Output ontology | Real example

quality_gate: Four audience tabs present (researcher, data engineer, ontology engineer, developer)
Use case gallery has at least three rows with real example links
No Docker or API terminology on P1-facing content
notes: Page already has audience tabs and core principle. Needs: use case gallery table with real examples, proof-of-production statistics.

primary.name: Evaluator
knows: Research data management concepts at a high level
does_not_know: RDF, triples, ontologies, or the semantic web
primary.goal: Assess whether DataStack fits their lab or institution — understand outputs and find the right entry point.
primary.key_gap: No technical background assumed. Needs concept-first explanations with real-world outcomes before any system detail.

secondary.name: Operator
secondary.goal: Get the stack deployed, configured, and running reliably.

secondary.name: Data Engineer
secondary.goal: Connect data sources, author mappings, and query transformation results.

secondary.name: Domain Scientist
secondary.goal: Upload their data, trigger the pipeline, and use or export FAIR-compliant results.
